title: Stop, Albert. Stop!
description: A suspicious person is lurking around the Cathedral. Sister Victoria wants someone to deal with them...

mainQuestExcel.title: Stop, Albert. Stop!
mainQuestExcel.description: A suspicious person is lurking around the Cathedral. Sister Victoria wants someone to deal with them...

dialogs.text: Where are you hiding, you pesky little...
What are you looking for?
Me? Oh— I'm looking for a very dodgy person.
His name is Albert and he always lurks around the Cathedral during the day.
He looks like he's up to no good. I'm worried he's plotting something bad...
Can you chase him off for me?
Go, Barbara, go!
Hi, what's the matter?
Sister requests that you leave this place immediately.
Leave? What did I do wrong?
Oh, I've already told the Knights of Favonius all about you and your antics!
What!? What am I supposed to have done? Tell me!
Me? Me, sneaking around, acting suspiciously, and plotting evil deeds? You guys have got this all wrong!
*sigh* ...Do you know Barbara? She's Mondstadt's angel.
Many people in Mondstadt admire her, including me.
In fact, I am head of the Barbara fan club.
The Knights of Favonius will be here shortly.
L—Let me finish! I really look up to Barbara. I want to be like her — I want to do something for Mondstadt.
But I'm just an ordinary person with ordinary abilities. The best I can do is to do some sweeping around the Cathedral.
But Miss Victoria never listens to me, she just says she wants me gone.
Recently I noticed that no one has swept away the leaves around the Cathedral for a while. But if I tried to explain to Miss Victoria, she wouldn't understand...
Can you help me sweep away the leaves? For Mondstadt... And for Barbara?
Alright then...
Thanks so much! Off you go then.
Fine, if it gets you out of here...
Hey! I thought I just explained how I'm not a bad guy!
Well, okay. Sweep away the leaves for me, and I'll be gone.
The Knights of Favonius will be the only ones doing any sweeping up around here...
I'm trying to do a good deed here! You don't need to report every little thing to the Knights of Favonius!
Alright, alright, you win. I'll be out of here as soon as the leaves are gone.

flow.stepDescription: Sweep up the pile of leaves

dialogs.text: Keeping the Cathedral free of dead leaves is a service to Mondstadt and to Barbara!
Have you finished sweeping yet?
Yep. All gone.
Thank you. The Cathedral looks much better now! I'm sure Barbara will feel better for it...
But, please don't tell Barbara about this.
The point here is to reduce her burden; telling her about it would only add to it.
As we agreed, I'll be on my way now. See? Nothing to worry about.
See you again soon... Maybe? Who knows.

I have an update about Albert.
Has he left?
Yes, he's gone.
Well, that's that sorted... But, what on earth were you doing sweeping leaves just now?
Never mind, I suppose no more leaves means one less excuse Albert can use to get near the Cathedral in future.
These gifts are my way of saying thank-you. Take them, and may the Anemo Archon protect you.
If there's nothing else, I should get back to work. You should get back to yours, too.
